projectDescription: A Java toolkit for visualizing and parsing binary file formats — including .class, .dex, .elf, .zip, .bmp, .jpeg, and .png — through a desktop GUI viewer, a web interface, and an HTTP API.
keyFeatures: Desktop Swing GUI viewer for interactive binary file inspection
Web server with HTTP API for programmatic file parsing
Plugin-based architecture — each file format is a separate module
Tree-node output per file — each node maps to byte range, start offset, and length
Docker support for the web server module
Drag-and-drop file opening in the GUI
Standalone format JARs usable in other Java projects
publicApiSurface: GET /api/v1/formats — list supported formats and file extensions
POST /api/v1/parse?name=Foo.class — parse file bytes, return JSON tree
FileFormat (abstract class) — base class for all format parsers
PosDataInputStream — positional data input stream for binary parsing
JTreeNodeFileComponent — tree node value carrying start/length/icon/description
ClassFile extends FileFormat — Java .class file parser
ZIPFile extends FileFormat — ZIP archive parser
BMPFile extends FileFormat — BMP image parser
DexFile extends FileFormat — Android DEX file parser
ElfFile extends FileFormat — ELF binary parser
ParseService — server-side service: parse(bytes, fileName), formatsJson(), findPlugin(fileName)
